$doc: Each entry maps an external CLI tool name to its absolute path on the host. Set a value to null (or omit the key) to fall back to a PATH lookup via shutil.which(). To override any of these for your personal setup without polluting the repo, copy this file to 'tools.local.json' (gitignored) and edit the values there -- it takes precedence over this file. The command-line overrides (--jadx PATH, --apktool PATH, etc.) still win over both files for one-shot use.
